source: Grok (grok.com, Expert), night order 5 of 30 September 2026, the vague-message eval (RETURN_5_GROK_Vague_Message_Eval). Thirty everyday low-key openers, texts unchanged. Ported 4 October 2026 under ruling 5 of 3 October 2026 with every expectation written from the ruled rule: a first vague message gets a question (UNRESOLVED, nobody seated), and its rider, a lone weak word or fragment never seats anyone and never sets a hold. Grok's own expectations (22 accepted, 8 known gaps naming the character the policy of 30 September seated) stand in its return file, which is never edited; each ported case keeps Grok's why and carries a port_note.
description: Thirty single-turn vague openers. None is a crisis statement. Each expects the no-signal policy (ADR-0011, as amended by ruling 5 of 3 October 2026) to ask instead of seating a character with confidence, with no hold set. tests/test_vague_messages.py checks the no-hold half directly.
